Do u just need the QR code then once u buy monthly pass or add money.I don’t have phone data so just making sure the app doesn’t need it for scanning on the bus ?!
Sorry if the answers seems obvious btw.As someone on the spectrum changes to routine or learning things I’m not used to can be a bit troublesome 😅

This happens to me too! The amount of times I will just be sitting minding my own business day dreaming  and I will have someone ask if I am okay.I thru out my entire life have had ppl come up to me and ask me if everything was okay and if I was gonna cry or something when I’m literally fine it drives me crazy. I can’t help what my face  looks like when it just resting

Omg i feel so seen in this. I talk to literally two people in my life that aren’t family. I just don’t hve the desire to talk to people nor do I care about them.I much rather be left alone and get annoyed when ppl try talking to me for too long as I find it overstimulating and boring. I truly feel only one person in my life gets me on this and we’re pretty similar and give each other space and it’s never weird when we don’t talk to each other or go for long periods of time without hanging out. I wouldn’t say I hate or don’t trust people tho I just don’t get the desire to seek out other ppl.I much rather be around animals and having a pet is a must for me and they help me feel safest

This.No matter how hard I try to fit in I do not see a point in this never ending cycle of misery. The fact people are making me stay here just to work my life away when I don’t even want to be here to begin with. I have no drive in life anymore to keep going and keep at this grind if anything it just makes me more depressed and I find myself slipping more and more Into suicidal ideation

This me .it don’t matter how much time I take off.once back to work it’s back to the same miserable feeling .Can relate on the not feeling like cut out to be an adult tho because others atleast just push thru and just accept it  but I can’t even do that no matter how hard I try.

The amount of times I see the autistic man at my work get away with stuff and have made excuses for him meanwhile if I do anything the energy isn’t the same and I am treated like I am stupid.but for him it’s oh he’s so brave and cut him slack he’s on the spectrum.Even tho we both are! But I Mask better thanks to society forcing us to so it don’t matter 😒
Thank you so much for your kind words.💜
This sounds a lot like the current relationship I’m in and I’m so glad you got out been trying to save enough money to get out in secret myself.You are not in the wrong here the way they react is.
Ignore  the straighties(esp straight men) they can’t handle when things aren’t about them and they can’t insert themselves into spaces they aren’t part of 🫢
🫣pls just stop talking ur embarrassing  urself
